n_locations: int, total number of locations, including the depot; locations are numbered 0 to n_locations-1.
depot_index: int, location number of the depot, in the range 0 to n_locations-1.
scores: list[float], length n_locations; scores[i] is the positive score of location i, including the depot score.
distance_matrix: list[list[float]], symmetric distance matrix of shape [n_locations][n_locations]; distance_matrix[i][j] is the travel distance of the direct undirected link between locations i and j, in the same unit as distance_budget; positive when i≠j, with diagonal entries distance_matrix[i][i]=0.
distance_budget: float, maximum total travel distance allowed for the single round-trip route, in the same unit as the distances in distance_matrix.
